caveats:
Administrative level 1P-codes are not consecutive; level 1 P-codes start with p-code "ID11" instead of "ID01”.

Some administrative level 3 and 4 names include slashes (/ or \) that may indicate alternate names. They may need to be separated and placed into alternate name fields.

name: cod-ab-idn
notes:
Indonesia administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 34 province (provinsi)  
- Admin 2: 522 city, district, regency (kota, kabupaten)  
- Admin 3: 7069   
- Admin 4: 81912   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 01 April 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 08 April 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 08 April 2020: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
